 Luan Peres rescues Santos with stoppage time header as Bahia held 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Santos 1-1 Bahia at Estádio Urbano Caldeira, with Luan Peres equalising in the third minute of second half stoppage time to keep Bahia seventh and Santos eighth in the Brasileirão.
 Luciano put Tricolor Baiano ahead in the 39th minute, drilling in from outside the box after a VAR review confirmed the strike.
 OneFootball Videos
 Neymar was sent off (45.).
 After the restart, Peixe pushed hard and goalkeeper Ronaldo stood tall, repeatedly denying the hosts. Substitute Benjamin Rollheiser then delivered the telling cross from a corner for Peres to glance home deep into second half stoppage time.
 Peixe registered 11 shots on target from 23 attempts and forced 14 corners. Ronaldo made 10 saves to preserve Bahia's lead until the late leveller.
 Next, Peixe host Palmeiras. Tricolor Baiano welcome São Paulo.
